key_reasoning.reason: A single component, ProjectBudgetService: the platform-hard-limit-zero guard sits in the shared group category validator (_validate_group_categories), and both the create_project_budget_group and update_project_budget_group paths go through it before any persistence. No router, model or repository changes.

The validator already rejects a missing platform category, negative or NaN pct and a wrong pct sum, each with a 400 ExtendedHTTPException. The zero-platform rule copies that pattern, and the existing parameterized invalid-value test template covers the enumerated edge cases (platform 0, a tiny positive value, zero soft budgets, zero secondary pct), so no edge-case bump applies. Easy to roll back.
The diffstat shows 2 files: the service module and its existing group-creation test module, both modified. 112 insertions, 3 deletions.

Total 9 sits on the XS/S boundary. It leans lower because Technical Risk is S and existing validation patterns cover nearly all of the change. This matches bundled XS example epmcdme-10101 more closely than S example epmcdme-10102, which touches API and Service.
